newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Good Guys FY97 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Good Guys FY97 EPS view cut.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it lowered its estimate for FY97 on Good Guys Inc to a loss of $0.15 a share from a loss of $0.05.

-- EVEREN noted that the company reported Q1 results below EVEREN's expectations but said in a report, "Given the difficult overall environment for consumer electronics, we do not find the results that surprising."
-- Good Guys is an electronics retailer. Its stock was trading at 6-1/4, off 1/8.
